summary.prose: Build accountable completion checks and a canonical review publisher on the completed recovery layer. Preserve evidence, independent-party and verdict rules while making publication idempotent across crashes and concurrent requests. Deliver the internal S5 capability without activating the new engine or repeating model judging.

tasks.title: Validate accountable completion at one accepted checkpoint
tasks.summary: Add completion-types.ts and completion-assessment.ts with exact sc5 assessment/receipt types and fail-closed coverage checks. Consume verified sc2/sc4 state and current approved pins/party records; do not execute reviewers or accept new final deltas.
acceptanceChecks: Exact CompletionAssessmentV1 and ReviewCompletionReceiptV1 shapes match approved sc5.
Every required task/check/design/change/criterion/impact row and latest selected block disposition is checked against pinned basis and trusted receipt closure.
Missing/pending/unverified rows, unfinished blocks or outstanding work return incomplete; unsupported satisfaction/applicability refuses.
Unplanned changed scope remains required; conflicting expectations or unknown/same author-reviewer return conflict without weakening requirements.
Stale source/BUILD/contract/policy compatibility returns stale with reasons; findings can form accountable completed WARN/BLOCK.

tests.name: Completion validates every required row block evidence and independent party
Completion rejects stale conflicting and unsupported coverage without canonical writes

tasks.title: Adapt accepted findings to versioned canonical review records
tasks.summary: Add completion-artifact.ts and extend canonical CodeReviewBody with investigation grounding and compact versioned linkage. Reuse or extract runner count/verdict/build validation without invoking judges; update necessary internal type guards while retaining legacy full/degraded behavior.
acceptanceChecks: All accepted findings retain criterion, severity, confidence, evidence/expectation identity and accountable locations; unknown or unmappable dimensions refuse rather than drop.
HIGH yields block, MED warn and LOW pass under existing code-review fold; source-only/indexed investigation inputs have the same verdict policy.
New investigation records require version/sourceMode/run/subject/policy/checkpoint/coverage/operation linkage; legacy records remain readable with their existing degraded warn cap.
Metadata records authenticated reviewer and reviewed BUILD fingerprint/revision; no raw ledger/evidence collection embedded in artifact JSON.
No judge rerun, automatic approval or external tool registration.

tests.name: Canonical investigation adaptation preserves finding identity severity and confidence
Investigation mode parity and legacy full degraded verdict compatibility

tasks.title: Freeze one immutable publication intent and coverage snapshot
tasks.summary: Add completion-publication.ts to stage validated coverage and candidate references plus deterministic operation identity, expected canonical revision/absence and trusted pins. Enter completed sc4 withPublicationFence and reuse its frozen reference on retries.
acceptanceChecks: Intent binds run/subject/policy/terminal checkpoint, candidate/coverage digests, canonical target, expected prior revision or explicit absence, BUILD and party provenance.
Coverage snapshot retains basis/ledger/trusted receipt references outside artifact JSON; staged-but-unaccepted values are not publication authority.
No active attempt or non-publishable assessment enters publication; completed status resolves existing receipt without new mutating callback.
Identical retry reuses original frozen intent; conflicting checkpoint/intent is refused by consumed sc4 capability.
Do not change sc4 journal/private events, deadline/fencing or recovery semantics.

tests.name: Immutable publication intent binds candidate coverage target and expected revision
Completed sc4 fence freezes original intent and refuses conflicts without duplicate recovery

tasks.title: Publish through the canonical artifact queue with revision checks
tasks.summary: Add completion-publisher.ts guarded persistence using the daemon-owned ArtifactStore/History/LifecycleService. Support explicit absent-head creation and expected-revision update under the existing canonical queue, with fresh ownership/pin checks inside the mutation boundary.
acceptanceChecks: Canonical mutation compares frozen expected absence/revision atomically under the existing artifact queue; no check-then-write race or direct JSON overwrite.
Same operation plus exact subject/checkpoint/content returns existing revision with no new write/logged round.
Different/newer/human-edited canonical head returns conflict and is not overwritten.
Recheck current-owner assertion, independent party and pinned source/BUILD/contracts immediately before canonical mutation.
Validate adapted record in memory and verify persisted head/revision after lifecycle write; two stores are treated as recoverable commits, not one atomic transaction.

tests.name: Canonical artifact queue creates or updates only the frozen expected revision
Owner freshness and canonical identity checks refuse concurrent or edited heads

tasks.title: Reconcile canonical writes and persist terminal completion receipts
tasks.summary: Complete publisher retry/recovery: reconcile frozen operation against canonical head/history after lost ACK, create immutable sc5 receipt, and record it through sc4 only after the publication callback queue releases.
acceptanceChecks: Crash after canonical write but before terminal receipt resolves the same operation/revision without rerunning judges or appending a duplicate CR.
Receipt binds run/subject/terminal checkpoint/canonical ID and revision/verdict/coverageRef and is durable before success returns.
Identical terminal replay returns original receipt read-only; mismatching head/content/receipt reports conflict.
Owner/freshness loss or callback timeout cannot become completion; respect sc4 revoked guard and non-reentrant queue contract.
Partial/failed execution never produces a passing CR; accepted findings and usage limitations remain intact.

tests.name: Lost canonical write acknowledgment reconciles one revision and terminal receipt
Terminal replay conflict and revoked callback authority cannot manufacture completion

tasks.title: Render canonical investigation reviews and preserve approval compatibility
tasks.summary: Update canonical CR rendering and existing completion-evidence readers for versioned investigation records, with deterministic view regeneration. Preserve legacy record, independent review and explicit override behavior; keep new engine activation capability-gated for S6.
acceptanceChecks: Canonical view exposes compact subject/checkpoint/coverage linkage and explicit source mode without raw evidence dumps.
Rendering failure after valid canonical persistence is repairable without a second artifact revision or lost result.
Existing full/degraded records, severity/confidence and human BUILD approval/override semantics remain unchanged.
Unsupported investigation versions/modes refuse explicitly; older strict consumers are not claimed automatically compatible.
No production engine selection, new MCP phases, tracker messaging or user approval performed.

tests.name: Canonical investigation rendering regenerates without another content revision
Legacy records independent approval overrides and unsupported versions retain explicit behavior

tasks.title: Verify complete publication across crashes and concurrent requests
tasks.summary: Integrate complete/incomplete ledgers, real canonical lifecycle store and completed sc4 fence with bounded crash/fault fixtures. Prove coverage, fresh ownership, canonical CAS, receipt replay and mode/legacy parity; export only the internal S5 composition boundary.
acceptanceChecks: All missing evidence/coverage/block cases and conflicting or non-independent inputs produce no successful canonical publication.
Real crash/lost-ACK tests around intent, canonical commit and terminal receipt converge to one operation/revision/receipt.
Concurrent completion and edited/newer heads cannot duplicate or overwrite canonical result; stale pins/owner between assessment and CAS refuse.
Identical source/index accepted state produces equal verdict and explicit impact limitations; pending usage never becomes invented coverage or tokens.
Focused completion/recovery/canonical-lifecycle/legacy compatibility suites and production build pass without live LLM or whole-repo sweep; one required code review after build.

tests.name: Completion crash concurrency and stale pin matrix converges to one canonical result
Complete blocked warned and incomplete review outcomes preserve mode and coverage semantics
Focused completion recovery canonical lifecycle compatibility suites and production build

Frozen publication intent and completed sc4 prerequisite consumption.
Canonical publication protocol and recoverable receipts.
